from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal, List

class CaseRecord(BaseModel):
    """The classification record for a single judgment document."""
    doc_title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title as named in the text")
    categories: List[Literal['管辖案件', '赔偿案件', '行政案件', '民事案件', '刑事案件', '执行案件']] = Field(description="The case categories identified for this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: List[CaseRecord]
